food_preferences: avoids slimy textures and uncommon meats
user_profile.travel_style: experience-maximizer — breadth over depth, moves between places, packs it in especially when unlikely to return

attributes.travel_pace: breadth over depth — maximise experiences, especially in places unlikely to revisit
attributes.morning_energy: active — runs, swims, outdoor time before the day opens up
attributes.evening_style: social first (dining out, dancing), comfortable wind-down (game night, movie) to close
attributes.splurge_preference: private or exclusive access to a unique experience — not just a room upgrade
attributes.adventure_threshold: all-or-nothing: either genuinely extreme outdoor activities or real relaxation — no light tourist thrills (explicitly dislikes ziplines and 'mild' activities)
attributes.nature_connection: mountains and isolation trigger the deepest travel satisfaction; wildlife encounters are emotionally significant
attributes.food_personality: adventurous but grounded — orders things never tried before, loves sharing plates, seafood and braised/roasted flavors; beer or cocktail always on the table
attributes.arrival_instinct: coffee or a beer, then quick hits of nearby must-see sights before settling in
attributes.group_dynamic: social traveler — enjoys shared experiences, group dining, dancing; also comfortable with intimate wind-down

attributes.travel_pace: depth over breadth — prefers 2-3 destinations on a 2-week trip, settles in and nests rather than racing; directly conflicts with Nir's breadth preference — reconcile by choosing 3 stops max with 3+ nights each
attributes.morning_energy: relaxed start — sleeps in a little, eases into the day (farmers market, coffee, reading)
attributes.evening_style: dinner with friends or partner, something local and special to close the day
accommodation_priorities: space to unpack and settle in — unpacks on longer trips, not living out of a suitcase
attributes.splurge_preference: luxury relaxation experiences — catamaran charter or spa day; not adventure-access like Nir
attributes.adventure_threshold: will join activity if already in motion and it flows naturally; resistant to switching modes mid-day ('not getting on a boat just to snorkel if we're not already on it')
attributes.food_personality: #1 non-negotiable — tons of different local culinary experiences; authenticity above all (hole-in-the-wall family spots, grandma's cooking, what locals eat — not tourist restaurants)
attributes.arrival_instinct: explore accommodation grounds first, get coffee, settle in before venturing out — opposite of Nir
aversions: tourist-saturated places — says congestion actively detracts from the experience (cited Bangkok, Mykonos)
attributes.nature_connection: coastal and panoramic views are her anchor; appreciates urban panoramas too
attributes.cultural_interest: drawn to genuine authentic moments — real daily life, not the tourist version; notices animals (stray dogs/cats), photographs local culture

trips.summary: Honeymoon trip. NZ covers Rotorua (Māori culture), Taupo/Tongariro (Alpine Crossing), Queenstown (adventure base, Milford Sound), Kaikōura (wildlife en route). Fiji likely Mamanuca Islands. Flying from Chicago ORD. Leading itinerary: fly into AKL, drive north NI, domestic flight to QZN, end in Fiji.
